title: Module restrictions along strict-local pointed-neighbourhood sections
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $B$ a scheme, and $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to B$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O^{sh}_{B,s}$ with its existing small affine-neighbourhood model and structure map $g$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. For every module sheaf $F$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and representative pointed affine etale neighbourhood $j$, define its section restriction to $\Gamma(S,g^{-1}F)$ by applying the inverse-image adjunction unit to sections on $j$, restricting along the pointed limit leg, and the canonical terminal-object/global-sections comparison [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor]. The geometric germ is that of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].
